_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Group ID = the channel number shown on the unit's LED display.
_healing_comment: Both off by default. auto_repair puts a TV found on the wrong channel back; auto_nudge_on_signal_loss re-acquires one that has lost its stream.
_bounce_comment: Spare Group ID that identify and re-acquire bounce through. Omit to use the highest ID no transmitter of yours uses.
_discovery_comment: Ranges the Scan network button sweeps. Keep them to subnets that might hold devices: a sweep of tens of thousands of empty addresses is an ARP flood. interval_hours 0 means only when asked.
_setup_comment: Where a factory-reset device appears, and the netmask and gateway to prefill when commissioning one. 192.168.1.12 is the documented default for a receiver; a transmitter is 192.168.1.11.
_channels_comment: One per transmitter. multicast_group is optional: read it off a transmitter's web page with tools/probe.py, and switch output becomes readable in channel names.
_receivers_comment: One per TV. expected_group_id is the channel it should show, which is what turns drift detection and one-click repair on. note records anything deliberate. enabled false files it under Spares / In storage.
